action.permissions.reason: selected SDK wire has no interaction channel

capabilities.reason: conservative descriptor for pinned SDK wire

run.cancel.reason: selected SDK wire has no cancel request

run.replay.reason: bounded adapter journal; gaps are explicit and there is no native replay request

run.resume.reason: selected SDK wire has no resume request; OAP resume replays the adapter journal

session.compaction.policy.reason: a --patch layer on this session's runtime sets compaction-basic's thresholdRatio for share, or disables it for off; its headroom still caps the threshold, and tokens is refused

session.message.delivery.auto.reason: accepted only for known idle sessions and normalized to start

session.message.delivery.queue.reason: overlapping native followups are outside the adapter contract

session.message.delivery.steer.reason: selected SDK wire has no steer request

session.message.submit.reason: receipt plus entered direct-user message proves start

session.open.reason: one process and native session per OAP session

session.open.reopen.reason: the harness stores sessions, but the pinned SDK wire has no request to load one, so a reopen is declined rather than read behind the harness

session.reasoning.reason: initialize carries reasoningEffort for the runtime this session starts; the DeepSeek route takes off, low, high and max

session.state.reason: reducer-owned live projection; no native query
